This issue tracks explicit open questions in the [wiki](https://sw-wiki.maxsp.de/parts/part-radar-advanced-missile).

The quotations below preserve the scope of each source. A resource-only article can lack a formula that a separate native-code investigation has partly recovered. Reconcile those findings before treating every quoted item as wholly undecoded.

## Recorded gaps

**Practical behavior guidance**

> Range is configuration; the detection model was not decoded.

- [wiki/data/behavior.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/behavior.json), `/families/95/limitations/0`

**Practical behavior guidance**

> Detection distance against target size at minimum and maximum FOV.

- [wiki/data/behavior.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/behavior.json), `/families/95/sections/1/body`

## Completion criteria

- Recover the relevant routine or run a reproducible measurement against the identified game build.
- Record equations, units, bounds, assumptions and executable addresses or measurement inputs.
- Update the wiki guidance and its extractor, retaining citations and any remaining uncertainty.
- Add or update an interactive graph when the recovered formula supports one.
- Re-run the relevant source checks and website checks.

comments.body: Partly answered in 7ab694a (investigation/sensors-radio.md). The remaining open items are listed on the wiki page.

Narrowed in 19762b5 (investigation/force-cap.md): the radar_type 1 selectors and scan matrices are decoded. Still open: the full scan frame, the six plane normals and the handedness of the reported angles.
